name: create-deb
description: Package scripts, applications, or services as Debian (.deb) packages, with reference docs and maintainer-script templates.

interface.shortDescription: Package scripts and apps as Debian (.deb) packages.
interface.longDescription: create-deb packages any script, application, or service as a Debian (.deb) package for system-wide installation. It ships reference docs for control files, maintainer scripts, and common pitfalls, plus templates for control, postinst, and postrm.
interface.defaultPrompt: Package this project as a Debian (.deb) package with the create-deb skill.
